verdicts.title: Karchmer-Wigderson Games for Hazard-free Computation
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present a Karchmer-Wigderson game to study the complexity of hazard-free formulas. verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes a Karchmer–Wigderson game for hazard-free formulas as a bridge between monotone and Boolean KW games; it makes no claim about immanants, perfect matching, or depth lower bounds tied to representation-theoretic widths.

verdicts.title: Multiparty Karchmer-Wigderson Games and Threshold Circuits

verdicts.title: The Number of Perfect Matchings in Möbius Ladders and Prisms
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The 1970s conjecture of Lovász and Plummer that the number of perfect matchings in any $3$-regular graph is exponential in the number of vertices was proved in 2011 by Esperet, Kardoš, King, Král', and Norine. We give the exact formula for the number of perfect matchings in two families of $3$-regular graphs.
